title: Boundary wall maximum height, R10-R40 (3.5 m)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.9.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, maximum boundary wall height: R10 - R17.5 3.5m; R20 - R25 3.5m; R30 - R40 3.5m. Where the subject site is adjacent to a site with a lower density code, the maximum wall length and height of the boundary wall between them is determined by the lower density code.

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: R10-R17.5 had no standalone boundary wall provision

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: One height rule for every band in R10-R40 (register ch3-062 to ch3-064). Height includes any retaining wall directly beneath the boundary wall (Table 3.4c note, Figure 3.4k; the fact is defined that way). Lower density code governs between differently coded sites (C3.4.4-r1). No boundary wall provision below R10.

verified.note: Table 3.4c starts at R10; Table 3A (p7) prints the 3.5m boundary wall height cell spanning R2 to R40 (carried as a flagged row in table-3A).
